cite.locator: documento inteiro (termo ausente em todas as páginas)

cite.quote: There is evidence from case reports, human studies, and animal studies associating LYRICA with serious, life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression when co-administered with central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including opioids, or in the setting of underlying respiratory impairment.
cite.note: Seção 7: com oxicodona, lorazepam ou etanol, "additive effects on cognitive and gross motor functioning were seen". Não há boxed warning sobre opioides para a pregabalina.

cite.quote: LYRICA may cause dizziness and somnolence. Inform patients that LYRICA-related dizziness and somnolence may impair their ability to perform tasks such as driving or operating machinery
cite.note: Mesma seção, estudos controlados em adultos: tontura em 30% vs. 8% com placebo; sonolência em 23% vs. 8%.

cite.locator: seção 5.6 Increased Risk of Adverse Reactions with Abrupt or Rapid Discontinuation
cite.quote: Following abrupt or rapid discontinuation of LYRICA, some patients reported symptoms including insomnia, nausea, headache, anxiety, hyperhidrosis, and diarrhea.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "taper the drug gradually over a minimum of 1 week rather than discontinue the drug abruptly"

facts.note: Não é boxed warning. Substância controlada (Schedule V) nos EUA.

cite.quote: As with any CNS active drug, carefully evaluate patients for history of drug abuse and observe them for signs of LYRICA misuse or abuse (e.g., development of tolerance, dose escalation, drug-seeking behavior).
cite.note: Seção 9.2: em usuários recreativos de sedativos, LYRICA 450 mg teve notas de "good drug effect", "high" e "liking" semelhantes às do diazepam 30 mg. Seção 9.3: sintomas após retirada abrupta "consistent with physical dependence".

cite.quote: LYRICA treatment may cause weight gain. In LYRICA controlled clinical trials in adult patients of up to 14 weeks, a gain of 7% or more over baseline weight was observed in 9% of LYRICA-treated patients and 2% of placebo-treated patients.

cite.locator: seção 2.7 Dosing for Adult Patients with Renal Impairment
cite.quote: In view of dose-dependent adverse reactions and since LYRICA is eliminated primarily by renal excretion, adjust the dose in adult patients with reduced renal function.
cite.note: Mesma seção: ajuste pela depuração de creatinina (Table 2), com dose suplementar após cada hemodiálise.

facts.note: A bula relata mortes em superdosagem só de pregabalina e em combinação com depressores do SNC; não quantifica a toxicidade.

cite.locator: seção 10 Overdosage (Signs, Symptoms and Laboratory Findings of Acute Overdosage in Humans)
cite.quote: Deaths have been reported in the setting of lone LYRICA overdose and in combination with other CNS depressants.

facts.note: Risco potencial baseado em estudos em animais (malformações esqueléticas em ratos e coelhos com exposição de 16 vezes ou mais a humana); a bula diz não haver estudos adequados em gestantes.

cite.quote: Advise pregnant women of the potential risk to a fetus.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "There are no adequate and well-controlled studies with LYRICA in pregnant women."

cite.quote: Because of the potential risk of tumorigenicity, breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with LYRICA.

monitoring.note: Alerta de classe dos antiepilépticos (não é boxed warning).

cite.quote: Monitor patients treated with any AED for any indication for the emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, and/or any unusual changes in mood or behavior.

review.notes: Sem dose_adult: a bula LYRICA dos EUA não tem indicação psiquiátrica (só dor neuropática, fibromialgia e crises focais); a dose para TAG exigiria outra fonte. Fora por falta de id: angioedema (5.1), hipersensibilidade (5.2), edema periférico e cautela na insuficiência cardíaca (5.7), prolongamento do PR (5.13, não é QT), queda de plaquetas (5.12, sem aumento de sangramento), CK/rabdomiólise (5.11). overdose_toxicity_high e pregnancy_risk são decisões de leitura: conferir.
